title: Krinner Tree Genie XXL — My 3rd Christmas With This Tree Stand. What a BEAST
description:
Third Christmas with the Krinner Tree Genie XXL. Drop the trunk in, pump the pedal, and one cable pulls every claw in at once. No more wrestling four bolts on the floor.

What I like:
• Foot pedal clamp — straightens the tree without crawling underneath
• 2.5-gallon tank with a water gauge that pops up when it's full
• Heavy base that keeps big trees from tipping
• XXL fits trees up to 12 ft with trunks up to 7 in.

Tip: size up. With a 10-ft tree, a second person guiding the trunk in still helps.

🎄 Krinner Tree Genie XXL: https://amzn.to/4jrMTXW
